name: 01 - Current position and program decisions
Planning start - Rev0 complete; Rev1 schematic in review and layout underway
exitEvidence: Status supplied 2026-10-31. Historical completion dates and percent complete are unknown; this is a planning anchor, not the actual Rev0 completion date.

name: Confirm US/Canada launch requirements and installation envelope
exitEvidence: Approved requirements: intended install location; 12 V baseline versus 24 V requirement; temperature, humidity, ingress, acoustic, GNSS, antenna, vehicle mounting, safe behavior and operating/survival power envelope. US + Canada launch confirmed; other markets are later change-controlled scope.

name: Agree certification and qualification matrix with accredited lab
exitEvidence: Written US FCC / Canada ISED route, exact ESP32 and nRF module grants/integration conditions, antennas and gains, RF exposure/use distance and simultaneous transmit cases; host emissions, GNSS receive performance, cellular/operator and Bluetooth qualification scope. Evaluate safety/battery/shipping and vehicle approval applicability. Lab quote, sample counts, modes and slot strategy recorded.

name: Select overseas build partners and reserve indicative capacity
exitEvidence: PCBA, mold/assembly and membrane/cable vendors shortlisted; quotes, Incoterms, import responsibility, tooling ownership, payment/release gates, English controlled drawings, weekly overlap meeting and change approval process. Lead times remain estimates until supplier commits. Confirm actual holidays/country.

name: Approve sample allocation and destructive-test budgets
exitEvidence: Allocate serialized boards/housings by test; suggested Rev1 15 boards, Rev2 30 boards, T1 20 sets, T2 60 sets, PVT 100 units subject to lab needs, destructive tests, spares, budget and demand. Counts are proposals, not purchase authorizations.

name: Evaluate physical SIM / eUICC provider and roaming
exitEvidence: Provider comparison covers US/Canada LTE-M/NB-IoT coverage, roaming/permanent roaming, PSM/eDRX, APN, activation, provisioning, supply/form factor, profile lifecycle, cost and operator approvals. Bench attach evidence and fallback physical SIM choice. Do not assume eSIM is merely a socket substitution.

name: Evaluate nRF9151 satellite service and supported hardware/firmware
exitEvidence: Check actual nRF9151 build code, compatible NTN modem/NCS release, provider service/bands/coverage, antenna/sky view, TN/NTN transitions, SIM profile, power budget, test access and approval route. Record working eval evidence or remaining gaps; not yet a launch promise.

name: G0 - Requirements, test strategy and supplier assumptions accepted
exitEvidence: Requirements, launch markets, qualification plan, sample budget and accountable role assignments accepted. Named owners and capacity still to be assigned.

name: 02 - Rev1 PCB and prototype housing release
Close Rev1 schematic review and BOM metadata
exitEvidence: Resolve reviewer comments and R2-03 MPN/tolerance/voltage/dielectric metadata; regenerate correct dev/production variants, BOM and netlist; run Altium compiler/ERC; unresolved risks have written containment. Saved source, reviewed PDF and exports agree.

name: Bound Rev1 input fault stresses before destructive testing
exitEvidence: Declare reverse battery, jump start, crank, pulse/load dump and USB overlap envelopes. Close R2-04 reverse comparator-pin injection allowance and transient peak/terminal stresses, or implement safe changes/bench containment. Static simulation alone is not fault qualification.

name: Complete Rev1 routing and RF / power / mechanical review
exitEvidence: Layout review checks switcher hot loops, return paths, antenna keep-outs/feed/matching, GNSS isolation, debug/test access, thermal copper, USB, pigtail, button/LED alignment, board outline and tolerances. DRC and 3D clearance review pass.

name: Rev1 PCBA DFM, AVL availability and release package
exitEvidence: CM acknowledges controlled fabrication/assembly package, stackup, impedance, stencil, polarity, firmware/debug access, approved substitutions, DNP variants and long-lead material status. Do not treat old exports as current production files.

name: G1 - Release Rev1 PCBA prototype run
exitEvidence: Signed Rev1 build release; quote and proposed lot approved; Rev1 is an engineering prototype with fault-test restrictions documented.

name: Design clamshell and interfaces for prototype manufacture
exitEvidence: Two plastic shell halves; fastening/seal strategy, wall/rib/draft and tool parting concept. USB access/sealing, power pigtail strain-relief and pull load path, user button/RGB light path, ESP32 reset/boot and nRF reset access, mounting and antenna clearances are defined.

name: Select humidity vent and MEMS acoustic membrane stacks
exitEvidence: Evaluate ePTFE humidity exchange and acoustic vent separately: RH response, mic insertion loss/bandwidth, cavity geometry, adhesives, supported bond land, contamination/condensation, grill/screen protection and material compatibility. Sharing a port requires evidence; vent rating is not whole-product IP certification.

name: Print housing variants and hand-build membrane/grill/pigtail prototypes
exitEvidence: Printed shell fits and hand-applied ePTFE, screen/grill, light pipe, seals and strain relief available; build record captures orientation/material/adhesive/cure. Include vent-only coupons and cable pull fixtures.

name: Evaluate printed enclosure fit, acoustic/RH and cable interfaces
exitEvidence: Fit real board or verified dimensional surrogate; test button/LED/dev access, USB insertion, pigtail pull/bend, grille damage, mic response/RH lag and condensation. Printed/handmade performance is screening evidence, not molded-process qualification.

name: 03 - Rev1 EVT build and integrated learning
Fabricate and assemble Rev1 engineering boards
exitEvidence: CM assembly report, AOI/X-ray where appropriate, component traceability, serial numbers and approved substitutions; staged release of first boards if feasible.

name: Rev1 board shipment, import and incoming inspection
exitEvidence: Air shipment received with customs paperwork, count and visual inspection; shipping damage and build discrepancies logged.

name: External gate - Rev1 bring-up firmware and diagnostic tools
exitEvidence: Versioned Rev1 pin map, flash/storage change, sensor addressing, charger source policy, USB-only latch-off recovery, rail sequencing/back-power prevention, fuel-gauge configuration and diagnostic capture ready. Dashboard/carportpy/proto compatible. Deliverables managed in software backlogs.

name: Bring up Rev1 PCBA with current-limited staged power
exitEvidence: Supply currents/rails verified before radios; USB enumeration, debug recovery, sensor/mic/button/RGB, flash, reset/boot and UART tested. Record boot firmware, serial and measurement setup.

name: Rev1 power, input fault screening and radio transient tests
exitEvidence: Measure reverse/positive stress within declared envelope, brownout and crank recovery, USB-only/battery absent/depleted modes, charge/source limits after reset, 3.2 V radio droop, thermal/efficiency and sleep draw; no unresolved unsafe stress. Destructive tests use allocated units.

name: Rev1 antenna, coexistence and EMC pre-scan
exitEvidence: In representative enclosure/cabling, assess BLE/Wi-Fi/cellular transmit and GNSS receive sensitivity/TTFF, coexistence/desense and switcher noise; bench/conducted checks plus radiated pre-scan; antenna candidates, retuning needs and lab modes documented.

name: Rev1 integrated membrane, housing and sensor experiments
exitEvidence: RH step response/hysteresis, thermal self-heating, acoustic response/noise, condensation/ingress screening and cable pull/bend. Confirm antenna placement, button feel/light visibility and development button access on actual assembly.

name: G2 - Rev1 EVT findings and Rev2 change list approved
exitEvidence: Issue log contains root cause, severity, evidence and Rev2 disposition; power/RF/mechanical feasibility demonstrated. No automatic pass because boards powered up.

name: 04 - Rev2 and tool-ready design freeze
G3a - Cellular SIM and satellite launch decision
exitEvidence: Select provider/form factor and antenna/band plan. NTN either included with supported build/firmware/service and certification budget, or deferred with feature disabled and excluded from launch claims. Unresolved NTN requirement holds Rev2 freeze; no implicit terrestrial-only waiver.

name: Rev2 electrical changes, worst-case closure and schematic review
exitEvidence: Rev2 closes EVT defects, input protection and power margins, selected connectivity/SIM, release variant and test access; tolerance/temperature/DC bias calculations, reviewed schematic and BOM signed.

name: Rev2 layout, RF and DFM review
exitEvidence: Production-intent outline, stackup, antenna matching/keep-outs, switcher layout, cable interfaces and fixtures reviewed; DRC/ERC and CM DFM accepted. No speculative changes after freeze without ECO.

name: Tool-ready enclosure, vent process and cable assembly DFM
exitEvidence: Production resin, surface/texture, shrink/tolerances, fastening, draft/parting/ejection, undercuts, gasket, pigtail molding or grommet strategy, USB sealing, membrane bond lands and grill process finalized. Humidity and acoustic stack validated; tooling scope includes any separate strain-relief/insert tools.

name: Cross-discipline design risk and verification review
exitEvidence: DFMEA and DVP&R link failures to tests: water paths, membrane detachment/blockage, cable pull, user interface, thermal, battery, radio, vehicle transients and recovery; test severities and quantitative pass limits signed before formal runs.

name: Approve mold design, tooling contract and trial plan
exitEvidence: Supplier confirms T1/T2 definitions, cavities, tool steel/life/ownership, resin, inspection points, trial videos/data, samples, ECO turnaround, capacity, shipping and holiday calendar. Texture/irreversible steel changes held until fit acceptance.

name: G3 - Release Rev2 PCBA and housing tooling
exitEvidence: Controlled Rev2 electrical and mechanical release and PO approval. Freeze intended antennas, cables, resin, SIM/service scope and certification configuration. Long-lead commitments explicitly approved by operator.

name: 05 - Rev2 / T1 first molded integration
Build Rev2 production-intent boards
exitEvidence: Controlled Rev2 lot with serial/lot traceability, inspection and approved exact BOM; proposed 30 boards sized to qualification plan.

name: Ship and inspect Rev2 boards
exitEvidence: Received boards match released configuration and allocation; incoming results logged.

name: External gate - Rev2 DVT and RF test firmware
exitEvidence: Pinned ESP32/nRF/modem/NCS versions, Rev2 hardware profile, production-intent power policy, logging and RF test modes; shared contracts/protobuf and dashboard/carportpy compatibility matrix. NTN launch decision implemented. Separate software backlog owns development.

name: Validate Rev2 electrical fixes before enclosed DVT
exitEvidence: Repeat affected power/fault tests, flash/debug recovery, supply margin and radio/sensor checks; compare Rev1 findings and confirm final component variants. Newly discovered Rev3 requirement is an ECO and schedule replan, not hidden rework.

name: T1 - Cut clamshell and included strain-relief tooling
exitEvidence: Mold progress evidence and tool acceptance checkpoints; approved resin and inserts available. This is 20 supplier working days, excluding provisional closure; no claim that all overseas vendors meet it.

name: T1 - First shots, supplier metrology and assembly samples
exitEvidence: As-molded samples from intended resin, cavity IDs, molding parameters, dimensional FAI and cosmetic/warp/sink observations; fit PCB and pigtail locally before sending samples. Proposed 20 sets plus membrane coupons.

name: T1 - Air shipment and incoming sample inspection
exitEvidence: Samples and FAI received with revision/cavity traceability; retain supplier reference set.

name: T1 - Mechanical and electrical assembly evaluation
exitEvidence: Evaluate tolerances, fasteners, seam/USB/pigtail, pull/bend, button/RGB/dev access, vent/grill assembly, mic/RH and final antenna behavior with Rev2. Collect change list before tool correction release; first molded parts are not preproduction approval.

name: G4 - T1 integrated evaluation and correction list accepted
exitEvidence: T1 loop target 6-8 weeks after freeze without supplier closure; baseline uses 20 + 5 supplier workdays, 5 calendar days transit and 5 engineering workdays evaluation. Electrical availability may drive later finish; holiday impact is explicit in supplier calendar.

name: Production-intent Rev2 / T1 EMC and RF readiness pre-scan
exitEvidence: Representative molded enclosure, antennas and cables pass readiness scans and coexistence/GNSS checks; host exposure and module integration assessment updated; any hardware changes enter T2 correction list.

name: 06 - T2 correction and preproduction validation
Freeze T2 correction package and final test limits
exitEvidence: Signed tool/assembly correction list and required electrical ECO. Baseline assumes minor corrections, no PCB respin or new mold. Major changes trigger explicit additional loop and renewed certification impact review.

name: T2 - Tool corrections and process adjustments
exitEvidence: Steel-safe corrections, approved finish/texture, vent application fixture and cure, grill retention, cable strain relief and sealing process incorporated; updated controlled drawing and inspection plan.

name: T2 - Repeat trial and supplier first-article inspection
exitEvidence: Final resin/cavity/process samples and dimensional FAI accepted for dispatch; proposed 60 assemblies covers lab/qualification plus spares. Supplier trial uses factory working days, with no assumed weekend overtime.

name: T2 - Air shipment and incoming inspection
exitEvidence: Final T2 samples and FAI received with revision/cavity/lot traceability; incoming damage/count checks complete.

name: T2 - Integrated mechanical and electrical evaluation
exitEvidence: Repeat affected dimensional, sealing/cable, thermal, mic/RH, RF/GNSS and power tests. Final resin/adhesive/cable/antenna/PCB/firmware configuration logged. Manufacturing repeatability compared across cavities/builds.

name: G5 - T2 preproduction candidate accepted
exitEvidence: T2 loop target 4-6 weeks from correction release excluding preceding change review; baseline 10 supplier workdays correction + 2 supplier workdays trial + 5 calendar days shipping + 10 engineering workdays evaluation. Candidate accepted for formal qualification/certification; MP still requires later gates.

name: 07 - Formal qualification and US/Canada market access
Confirm lab bookings, sample matrix and regulatory configuration
exitEvidence: Lab slots quoted/confirmed for forecast T2 availability with change policy; exact grant IDs, antennas, firmware/RF modes, accessory/cable variants and sample count documented. Schedule is not evidence a booking already exists.

name: Formal vehicle electrical / ESD qualification
exitEvidence: Execute signed installation-specific DVP&R: ISO 7637-2 transient and ISO 16750-2 electrical load categories as applicable, reverse battery, crank, jump start, load dump, hot plug, shorts, USB/source combinations and ESD (ISO 10605/IEC 61000-4-2 as scoped). Verify function/recovery and post-test leakage. No blanket automotive-certified claim.

name: Formal enclosure, environmental and cable qualification
exitEvidence: Run approved temperature/humidity/condensation, thermal cycle, vibration/shock/drop, ingress target, fluid/UV where installation requires, pigtail pull/flex, connector/button cycles and membrane/grill adhesion/contamination. Acoustic and RH checks before/after; confirm full-assembly ingress. Long-duration aging beyond this window adds explicit time.

name: US FCC / Canada ISED host RF, emissions and exposure assessment
exitEvidence: Final configuration tested/assessed against applicable rules and module grant restrictions, radio bands, Wi-Fi/BLE/cellular combinations, antenna/cable changes, RF exposure, host emissions and labels/user notices. Determine whether filings/permissive changes/new certification are needed; obtain written conclusion and reports.

name: Cellular/operator and conditional NTN acceptance
exitEvidence: Document PTCRB IoT/other applicable route and each selected carrier acceptance; supported module/modem and antenna configuration, OTA RF performance and SIM lifecycle proven. If NTN launches, provider/network approval evidence included; if deferred, disabled-build verification and no launch claim documented.

name: Complete Bluetooth product qualification
exitEvidence: Company membership, qualified-design reuse/testing route, product identity and submission complete; retain product qualification record before market distribution.

name: Battery, transport, material and product safety documentation
exitEvidence: Confirm actual cell/pack chemistry/configuration and applicable safety evaluation, protection/charging temperature behavior; UN 38.3 test summary for shipped lithium configuration and packaging requirements where applicable, supplier safety files, resin flammability and material declarations. New/modified pack testing requires a separate quoted loop; module approvals do not cover this.

name: Approve final labels, installation instructions and compliance file
exitEvidence: US/Canada applicable IDs and host labeling, bilingual Canadian notices where required, antenna/install separation and allowed environment/power ratings, approved accessory list, SIM/provider configuration and traceable reports. Assess other markets afresh for expansion.

name: Visible qualification / lab retest contingency
exitEvidence: Reserved capacity for one minor corrective/retest cycle. Major hardware, antenna, resin, battery or NTN-route change requires a new estimate; this reserve does not prove an approval.

name: G6 - Qualification and US/Canada release evidence accepted
exitEvidence: Signed qualification reports and required authorizations/acceptances complete for the exact sale configuration; unresolved deviations closed or formally limited before any customer distribution. NTN inclusion/deferment is explicit.

name: 08 - Manufacturing system and software handoff gates
Design production programming and end-of-line fixtures
exitEvidence: Fixture design covers protected power, contact access, ESP32 USB/UART and nRF SWD/modem programming, serial/MAC/IMEI/SIM association, rail/current tests, radio/GNSS checks, sensor/mic/RH, buttons/RGB and leak/vent tests where appropriate. Throughput and calibration/reference strategy defined.

name: Build and correlate fixtures with golden/reference units
exitEvidence: Fixtures delivered, limits derived from qualification, reference/failing-unit studies demonstrate detection, gauge repeatability assessed and station/firmware logs retained. Destructive qualification and end-of-line screens have distinct coverage.

name: External gate - Factory firmware, provisioning and test tools
exitEvidence: Versioned manufacturing images, RF test modes, locked test protocols, fixture automation/dashboard diagnostics, protected factory identity flow, authorized provisioning and serial/IMEI/SIM records; pass/fail output schema and calibration persistence. No private keys or credentials in build package/logs.

name: External gate - Integrated product release candidate
exitEvidence: Versioned ESP32/nRF/shared/protobuf, mobile tools/onboarding/OTA, dashboard and AWS contracts pass cross-repo integration: cellular/Wi-Fi/BLE paths, location, recording/relay, secure ownership, updates, factory reset/calibration retention, recovery and low power. Feature maturity is not inferred from README. Separate software project manages scope and iterations.

name: Create assembly SOPs, quality control and training package
exitEvidence: Work instructions for membrane cleanliness/bond/cure, grill/screen retention, torque, seals/pigtail/USB, ESD/rework and traceability; incoming/supplier quality, PFMEA/control plan, calibration, first-article approval and operator training. Golden unit and tooling/fixture backups retained.

name: Approve production material availability and logistics plan
exitEvidence: Approved AVL, alternatives via ECO, allocation and forecast for radios/SIMs/antenna/resin/ePTFE/adhesive/cable/battery; no speculative full MP purchase. Pilot materials authorized; freight/customs/battery transport plan and supplier change notifications defined.

name: G7 - Controlled pilot build readiness
after: SOP MATERIAL FIXBUILD SWFACT SWPRODUCT MARKET
exitEvidence: Released exact hardware/firmware/BOM/work instructions, calibrated validated test stations, material, required compliance evidence and trained operators. Approve proposed PVT lot and quality targets before build.

name: 09 - Pilot, production release and ramp
Run PVT pilot on intended overseas production line
exitEvidence: Suggested 100-unit lot uses intended staff, tools, resin/process and end-of-line tests. Record first-pass yield, defects/rework, cycle time, cavity/lot/serial traceability and process capability where sample size supports it; retain golden/reference units.

name: Ship pilot units and verify receiving / fulfillment process
exitEvidence: Pilot import, packaging, handling and shipment records verified; random receiving audit matches station records and serial/SIM identities.

name: Supervised US/Canada vehicle pilot and soak
exitEvidence: Representative vehicles/installations and routes exercise cellular/GNSS/Wi-Fi/BLE, power/crank/sleep, heat/condensation, onboarding/OTA/recovery and optional approved NTN; retain logs with consent. Three weeks is a discovery pilot, not lifetime reliability proof.

name: Close pilot defects and approve yield / quality evidence
exitEvidence: Critical/major issues closed with retest and ECO impact assessment; baseline proposed targets >=95% first-pass yield, 100% functional screen pass before ship and zero unresolved critical defects require owner approval. Verify RMA/repair/OTA support and traceability.

name: G8 - Authorize mass production release
exitEvidence: Operator approves production quantity/PO against demand, cash, capacity and accepted quality. Qualified configuration and golden sample locked; change control, stop-ship and field monitoring owners assigned.

name: Build first mass-production lot and controlled ramp
exitEvidence: Size of first MP lot set at G8; control plan, sampling/audit, complete serialized test records, yield monitoring and supplier capacity demonstrated; hold nonconforming units.

name: First MP lot outgoing audit and shipment release
exitEvidence: Outgoing functional/visual/packaging audit and documentation pass, approved labels/manuals/certification configuration checked; ship only released units with traceability and support readiness.

name: G9 - First mass-production lot ready to ship
exitEvidence: First MP lot accepted and released for shipment; subsequent ramp managed by yield, demand and field performance. Freight to customer is outside this ready-to-ship milestone.
